Chicago garden editorial spread with @jessicawildvip , shot by @jeffreydelacruzz, is still one of my favorite reminders that full glam is a flex, but restraint always has and always will pays the bills.

Airbrush skin, soft-focus eyes, breathable lips, and just enough polish to let her bone structure, freckles, and the greenery do the talking.. no baking, no heavy contour, no cut crease... no Temu lashes. (no shade @shoptemu )

Hot take:
The artists who stay booked aren’t always the ones doing the most.
They’re the ones who know when to stop.

Brands, agencies, editors, and brides don’t just want “pretty.” They want believable, versatile, editorial skin that still looks like a real human when you zoom in.

Anyone can:
- Pack on pigment and call it “full glam.”
- Copy a viral look they saw on TikTok.

But ask yourself, are you willing and able to:
- Create dimension with half the product?
- Keep texture of the skin under harsh light and HD lenses?
- Pull back when the location, styling, and model are already the story?

I’m curious:

Do you feel the majority still equates “more makeup” with “more talent,” or are we finally entering the era where the rest of the world has FINALLY caught up with what PROS have known for decades? Clean, refined glam is the real flex.

I want to hear from the PROS, models, clients and photo story tellers on this one. Tell me everything.

#chicagomakeupartist - #editorialbeauty - #airbrushmakeup #beautyphotographer #ProductionReady

芝加哥花园主题的时尚大片，和 @jessicawildvip 合作、由 @jeffreydelacruzz 拍摄，至今仍是我最喜欢的提醒之一：全妆很能炫实力，但克制一直以来、也永远都会让你有饭吃。

喷枪妆感的肌肤、柔焦眼妆、有呼吸感的唇妆，以及恰到好处的精致度，让她的骨相、雀斑和绿植自己说话……不做 baking 烘焙定妆、不做厚重修容、不画 cut crease……也没有 Temu 假睫毛。（无意冒犯 @shoptemu）

争议观点：
一直有活接的化妆师，并不总是那些做得最多的人。
而是那些知道什么时候该停手的人。

品牌、经纪公司、编辑和新娘想要的不只是“好看”。他们想要的是可信、百搭、有杂志大片感的肌肤，即使放大看也仍然像真实的人。

任何人都可以：
- 大量堆叠色彩，然后称之为“full glam”。
- 复制他们在 TikTok 上看到的爆款妆容。

但问问你自己，你是否愿意并且有能力：
- 用一半的产品打造出层次感？
- 在强光和高清镜头下保留肌肤纹理？
- 当场地、造型和模特本身已经是故事时，懂得收手？

我很好奇：

你觉得大多数人仍然把“更多化妆”=“更有才华”吗？还是我们终于进入了一个时代：世界其他人终于追上了 PROS 几十年来早就知道的事？干净、精炼的 glam，才是真正的实力展示。

关于这个话题，我想听听 PROS、模特、客户和影像叙事者的看法。全部都告诉我。
